snippet.title: Sandeep Swadia
snippet.description:
From homeless to billion-dollar boardrooms. From monk training to MIT. From stage concerts to M&A... I’ve lived more lives than a cat.

I've served as CEO and C-level exec at tech companies that created $40B+ in value. I also crashed and burned too. Failure teaches much faster than success.

Before business, I performed 1,000+ concerts with Grammy winners. As a teenager, I ran away from home, trained as a monk, and somehow ended up graduating from MIT. 

I started this channel to share guidance my 22-year-old self desperately needed but never got. Science, strategy, spirituality, and stories from your friend who’s been there, warts and all.

Currently, I live in the NYC area, serving on boards, advising AI startups and help ambitious leaders scale without losing themselves.

It's so awesome to see you here. Thank you, and I love you.

For brand partnerships,  podcast appearances, and speaking engagements, please reach out to Creative Artists Agency (CAA) at SwadiaSandeepGroup@CAA.com.

snippet.title: Sterzik
snippet.description:
Moin Leute, ich bin Sterzik, auch bekannt als Sebastian.

Ich bin seit 2013 auf Youtube unterwegs. Aber was mache ich eigentlich hier?

Auf diesem Kanal findet ihr vorwiegend Gaming Videos zu den aktuellsten Spielen, aber auch zu allbekannten Klassikern.
Zudem nehme ich euch ab und zu mit und zeige euch, wie mein Leben hinter den Kulissen aussieht in Form von vLog und Real Life Content.
Und wenn euch das nicht genug ist, werden euch gut Produzierte Sketches, auch mit anderen Youtubern erwarten, die euch richtig die Hirnhaut wegballern werden.
Habt Spaß und lasst euch von meinem Content berieseln.

Abonniert gerne den Kanal um nichts von mir zu verpassen!

snippet.title: Dan Martell
snippet.description:
My #1 passion is teaching.

#2 is building AI businesses.

I’ve built and exited 3x tech companies.

Invested in 100+ others.

Spend 98.2% of my time building AI startups at Martell Ventures (AI Venture Studio)

Wrote a WSJ best selling book https://www.BuyBackYourTime.com

Play life full out (wake surfing, snowboarding, mountain biking) at the highest level…

… and I love people and travelling the world with my family training and speaking on the biggest stages.

Oh, and did all that after ending up in jail and rehab at 17 years old.

It’s been a journey to say the least.
